scripts.lhci:mobile: rm -rf /tmp/cabana-lhci-mobile && CABANA_LHCI_PRESET=mobile pnpm exec lhci autorun --config=./lighthouserc.cjs --collect.outputDir=/tmp/cabana-lhci-mobile
scripts.lhci:desktop: rm -rf /tmp/cabana-lhci-desktop && CABANA_LHCI_PRESET=desktop pnpm exec lhci autorun --config=./lighthouserc.cjs --collect.outputDir=/tmp/cabana-lhci-desktop
scripts.lhci:all: pnpm run lhci:mobile && pnpm run lhci:desktop
scripts.lhci:all:baseline: pnpm run lhci:mobile && pnpm run perf:baseline:mobile && pnpm run lhci:desktop && pnpm run perf:baseline:desktop
scripts.lhci:all:dashboard: pnpm run lhci:mobile && pnpm run perf:dashboard:mobile && pnpm run lhci:desktop && pnpm run perf:dashboard:desktop
